name: InheritedSetting
description:
A setting that can come from a broader level (R6.9): workspace → organisation →
site → this entity. Inherited, it says where the value comes from and what it is, with
Override. Overridden, it says so ("Overridden for this device"), shows the control (or
the fields beneath), and offers Reset to inherit again. Enforced by a broader level, it
names the enforcer and cannot be overridden.
signature: ({ label, source, inheritedValue, overridden, onOverride, onReset, scope: scopeProp, control, children, enforcedBy, disabled, disabledReason, className, }: InheritedSettingProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: children
props.description: Fields under the row while overridden: a credential profile.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: control
props.description: The control for a setting row while overridden: a Switch, a Segmented.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: disabledReason
props.description: Why the setting cannot be overridden here (permissions). An enforcer supplies its own.

props.name: enforcedBy
props.description: A broader level enforces the value ("Orbit Workspace"): the row says "Enforced by Orbit Workspace" with a lock, offers no Override, and its disabled reason names the enforcer.

props.name: inheritedValue
props.description: The inherited value in words: "On", "v2c · port 161 · every 5 min".

props.name: label
props.description: Names the setting: "Show signed-in user's photo", "SNMP credentials".

props.name: onOverride
props.description: Start an override (copy the inherited value into the entity's own).

props.name: onReset
props.description: Drop the override and inherit again.

props.name: overridden
props.description: The entity sets its own value.

props.name: scope
props.description: Whose override it is: "this device" → "Overridden for this device".

props.name: source
props.description: Who the value comes from while not overridden, as the UI names them: "Orbit Workspace", "Central studio (site)", "the workspace".
